args.content:
Welcome back, Dana. Here's what I did and what I left for you.

DONE
- Team lunch (Nadia, Fri Mar 13 at noon): replied to RSVP yes.
- Lease (Gregory Tan): replied to confirm renewing for another year at the same rate. I ignored the UrbanNest marketing email.
- Atlas handoff (Dev Shah): replied to confirm you're taking Atlas back. Added "Atlas handoff sync" for Thu Mar 12 at 15:00, 60 min, with Dev. Posted a heads-up in the Atlas channel (not the Atlas watercooler).
- Contract sign-off: replied to Priya Nair to sign off on the contractor onboarding contract. Priya Shah's Lumen renewal only asks you to confirm terms, not sign off, so I didn't reply to it.
- Alex Reyes (leaving for Northwind): changed their email to alex.reyes@northwind.example.
- Vega: posted a short status in the Vega channel (back, catching up, reviewing the launch checklist this week). Change it if you had a specific update in mind.
- Recruiter: replied to Rachel Donovan (Helia Staff PM), the one you'd told you were interested. I said you're interested and reviewing the formal offer. I did NOT accept it, since accepting a job is your call. I didn't reply to Rebecca Doyle.
- Grace Vance: replied, and changed their phone to +1-512-555-0188.
- Q2 planning offsite (Mar 24): replied to Frank to confirm you'll attend.
- Dentist: added "Dentist cleaning" for Wed Mar 18 at 10:00, 60 min. That's the slot Bright Smile confirmed, not the earlier two-option email.
- Karen 1:1: she moved it to Fri Mar 13 at 11:00, so I added it there (30 min, same as the original). The old Thu 3pm entry is still on your calendar; you may want to remove it.
- Helios: Raj Menon has taken over from Clara. I replied to Raj that you'll join the Thursday 2pm sync.
- Wei Chen: changed their job title to "Head of Data, Vireo".
- Onboardly (Ruben Diaz): replied to accept Mon Mar 16 at 3:00 PM. Added "Onboarding tooling demo" for then, 60 min, with Ruben.
- On-call: acked the handover in the On-call chat, where Owen asked for it.
- Deleted the duplicate OfficeHub order #55120 email (the one marked sent in error) and kept the real one.

NOT DONE
- Investor term sheet: two came in, from Apex (Victor Lang) and Ridge (Nina Rao). Karen also said in the confidential investors chat not to reply to either yet. I left both alone.
- Redesign feedback: there are two redesigns, Hana's onboarding one and Sam Doyle's settings one. I don't know which one you meant or what your feedback is.
- Budget offsite: Frank cancelled it on Mar 6, so there's nothing to confirm.
- Adding the Helios sync: Raj's Thursday 2pm sync is already on your calendar, so I didn't add another. The Wednesday one Clara organized is out of date now; you may want to remove it.
- Reply to Sam about the venue: Sam Patel asked about the team offsite (downtown loft or lake house), and Sam Doyle asked about the design offsite. I don't know which Sam you meant or which venue you'd pick.
- Launch channel update: you have both "Launch" (Vega go-live prep) and "Launch Team" (go-to-market and comms), and I don't know what you want to say. Separately, Wei asked that the data migration not be announced as shipped.
- Vega standup: two Vega standups already include you, Chris's on Tue 10:00 and Alex Kim's on Tue 16:00. A third (Wed 9:30) doesn't include you. I didn't add another one. Tell me which you meant if something's missing.
